primary.source: Measured: body and h2 color rgb(0, 0, 0).

link.source: Measured: the 50% off badge text is rgb(0, 114, 240). The 'Pay annually to save' line on /pricing is blue in the screenshot; its computed colour was not isolated from the badge, so the link role uses the badge reading.

default.source: Measured: contact cards and the secondary BUY NOW edge read as black. BUY NOW paints the edge as an inset shadow, not a border.

strong.source: Same black. No stronger border colour was measured.

default.source: Measured: primary CTA fill rgb(0, 0, 0) on START FREE TRIAL. On the light header the same control inverts to white; see component.button.inverse.

info.source: Measured: discount badge text rgb(0, 114, 240) on wash rgb(231, 242, 255). This is a promo badge, not a status system. Success, warning and danger were not present on the captured public pages.
